subject: Mobile Development
title: Color and Contrast in Mobile Design
description: A micro-lesson that makes Color and Contrast in Mobile Design usable.

hook.text: Color isn't just decoration. It communicates hierarchy, state, and meaning in mobile apps.

buildup.text: WCAG guidelines require a 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text to be readable by all users.

discovery.text: Red means error. Green means success. Blue means interactive. These conventions are universal.

twist.text: 8% of men are colorblind. Designs that rely only on color fail for millions of users.

climax.text: Great color design works for everyone — in bright sun, at night, and for colorblind users.

punchline.text: Color must communicate, not just decorate.

quiz.question: What contrast ratio does WCAG require for readable text?
